title: AI lead management system for a Canadian immigration law firm
problem: Leads came in across WhatsApp, web forms, and calls, tracked by hand. Follow-ups slipped, with no single record of where a prospective client stood in intake.
approach: Connected WhatsApp Business API and Respond.io as the conversational front door, routed qualified leads into HubSpot, wired Calendly for self-service booking, and used Zapier to sync case status with CaseEasy.ca.

title: Japanese-language learning platform for Bangla & English speakers
role: Solo build · Mobile, backend, and admin panel
problem: Existing Japanese-learning apps aren't built for Bangla or English speakers, and most lose a learner's progress the moment they're not signed in.
approach: Flutter app on a FastAPI backend with PostgreSQL, Redis and Celery for background jobs. Built a guest-to-registered progress merge, an XP ledger for progression, and a deduplication pipeline for scraped vocabulary content.

impact.before: No Japanese app for Bangla speakers

title: BDNextStep.com — education & career portal for Bangladesh
role: Solo build · Platform, SEO, monetization strategy
problem: Bangladeshi students and early-career professionals don't have one dependable place for education and career guidance.
approach: Built on a custom domain with SEO-first content structure and a diversified monetization stack — AdSense, Ezoic, Adsterra, PropellerAds, and Monetag — so revenue isn't dependent on one network.

impact.before: No centralized education portal for BD

title: R&D bench — UI/UX redesigns, offline-first architecture, and applied AI experiments
problem: Most of what eventually ships starts as an open question — a redesign hypothesis, an offline-sync architecture, an AI integration nobody has tried in this exact combination yet.
approach: Current bench work includes a full UI/UX redesign strategy for an exam-prep platform (search-first navigation, Bangla typography, seasonal content strategy), and an offline-first personal finance app with Islamic finance tracking (Zakat/Sadaqah). Each starts as a working prototype before any line is called a 'feature.'
